example.question: Belfius' 2025 annual results press release (consolidated, 31 December 2025) and the Belfius Bank 2025 Pillar 3 report both quote the CET1 ratio and total risk exposure amount (TREA) at end-2025. What CET1 ratio and TREA does each document give for end-2025, and, using the end-2024 TREA figure that each document itself compares with (the press release's FY24 figure under CRR2, the Pillar 3 report's pro forma CRR3 figure), did TREA decrease or increase during 2025 in each document?
example.reference_answer: The press release gives a CET1 ratio of 15.9% and a total risk exposure of €72.1 billion at end-2025, compared with €75.2 billion at end-2024 (FY24 TREA under CRR2, slightly updated following a late Corep correction), i.e. a decrease of about €3.1 billion, which the release attributes to the entry into force of CRR3. The opposite directions are a basis difference (CRR2 vs pro forma CRR3 for 2024), not a contradiction; the press release figures are rounded and unaudited.

example.question: Fresenius Group's EBIT for fiscal year 2025 is €2,595 million (before special items) in the Q4/FY 2025 press release, but the Group EBIT in the consolidated segment reporting of the Fresenius consolidated financial statements 2025 is €2,310 million (after special items). How large is the difference, and which special items explain it according to the notes to the financial statements?
example.reference_answer: The difference is €285 million (€2,595 million before special items minus €2,310 million per IFRS). It equals the total EBIT special items of 2025 listed in note 3 of the consolidated financial statements: cost and efficiency programs -€174 million, legacy portfolio adjustments +€6 million, Fresenius transformation -€190 million, reduction of participation in Fresenius Medical Care +€85 million and legal and regulatory matters -€12 million, together -€285 million. In the segment reporting, Fresenius Kabi (€1,413 million) and Fresenius Helios (€1,328 million) are before special items, while the Corporate / Other column (-€431 million) is after special items and so contains the -€285 million on top of the -€146 million Group Corporate EBIT of the press release; hence the Group column of €2,310 million is EBIT after special items.
